decisions.reason: As software for process data archiving and reporting, it remains highly related to our automation and data capabilities, and our R&D plus research links give us strong capacity to refine rather than exit it.

The manhole floor door with integrated safety railing still draws on our infrastructure engineering and modular project knowledge, though its weaker fit with the digital growth path leaves some withdrawal risk.

The floating sludge extractor serves our water customer base but is the most niche and least digitally leveraged offer, so its learning benefits are narrower and we would redeploy resources to stronger platform products.

Control technology for water engineering machinery sits at the center of our machinery, automation, and service competence and can be improved through our internal development base, making continued offering the likely choice.
Flow measurement automation and system software closely matches our move toward connected, data-driven infrastructure management, so our existing software and systems knowledge supports keeping it.
